title: Pricing
description: Plan comparison composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Card, Badge, Button, Alert and Skeleton primitives: a serif title and one card per plan with its price, features and a call to action, the recommended plan outlined in --primary with a badge and the primary button, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — stacked plans list their features in two columns at @sm, the plans sit side by side and the title steps up at @md, and the block takes more room at @lg.
